page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m4.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.s6 family. It is equipped with 2 shared Intel Xeon 8269CY vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance features 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This server configuration does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network baseline bandwidth is rated at 0 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Due to its shared CPU allocation model and lack of bundled local storage, this instance offers a cost-efficient profile for workloads that do not require dedicated, continuous CPU resources. It is suitable for general-purpose applications, lightweight web serving, development environments, and small-scale database hosting where resource demands are intermittent.
